name: Cato Networks
tagline: Cloud-native SASE platform on a global private backbone
key_differentiators: Single converged platform — no policy/log fragmentation across SD-WAN and security
85+ PoP global private backbone reduces internet variability for SaaS
Strong story for organisations consolidating multiple point solutions
best_fit_for: Mid-market and enterprise consolidating SD-WAN and SASE on one platform
Global organisations with SaaS-heavy traffic patterns
Teams without dedicated security operations capacity
watch_outs: Less suited to best-of-breed buyers wanting Zscaler/Netskope alongside
Customer doesn't own the underlay — circuits sourced separately
Less mature than incumbents for very large multinational deployments
verification_notes: Capabilities verified against vendor documentation; PoP count cited in Cato public materials.
